semiconductor_relevance: High — Plansee SE specializes in high-performance materials essential for various semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Plansee SE is a leading manufacturer of powder metallurgically produced components, providing high-performance materials for semiconductor applications such as lithography, etching, and IC packaging. Their expertise in materials like molybdenum, tungsten, and tantalum ensures they meet the demanding requirements of the semiconductor supply chain.
capabilities: High-performance molybdenum and tungsten components for PVD coating
Thermal evaporation materials for semiconductor fabrication
Ion beam coating and treatment solutions

regional_presence.Austria: Founded in Reutte, Austria, Plansee has a significant manufacturing presence and operational base.
